text:
morgan: Heads up — found a gap in consent sync during role rollouts. Delegated admins can see a route in the console before quotas/policies are enforced at runtime. Repro steps below, @ashley can you take a quick look?

ashley: can you paste the repro? :eyes:

morgan: Quick repro: 1) flip route affinity to 'enterprise-only' in UI 2) start canary rollout 3) delegated admin now sees the route enabled in Console -> but runtime requests return 403. UI is showing effective permissions before the server-side policy/quota is committed.

deepak: sounds like a cache invalidation / ordering problem. We compute the client-side "effective permissions" from a cached entitlements snapshot and don't wait for commit acknowledgement.

morgan: exact change event we used (from audit log):
```json
{
  "actor": "morgan",
  "action": "update_route",
  "route": "tenant/alpha/chat",
  "changes": {"routing_policy": "enterprise-only"},
  "commit_id": "c5a1d2",
  "time": "2026-03-20T15:12:03Z"
}
```

ashley: two high-level fixes: 1) ensure server-side commit + audit entry is created before updating the client snapshot, or 2) mark the preview as "potentially stale" in the UI until server ack. First is safer but can block UX.

julie: prefer not blocking the UI. Add a visible "stale" badge + last_synced timestamp and let org admins opt into a stricter mode. Also add telemetry so we can measure how often previews are stale.

console-bot: Deploy bot: Canary rollout started for entitlements-service v2.8.1 by @morgan — status: IN_PROGRESS.

deepak: +1 for last_synced_at + stale badge. Implementation idea: SDK returns {effective_perms, snapshot_version, last_synced_at}, UI shows a yellow indicator if snapshot_version < server_commit_version. Add a short debounce (1–2s) before flipping the preview.

ashley: another edge: routing policy flips that cross regions (hosted -> dedicated or region fallback) require quota evaluation at the edge. Console preview doesn't have region context so it can lie about allowed routes. We should include routing_hint in preview requests (e.g., preferred_region) or mark route as region-dependent.

morgan: plan: prototype last_synced_at + stale badge + an org-level "strict-commit-preview" toggle that blocks preview flips until server ack. Will open PRs for SDK + UI + entitlements service changes today. Ship to canary first. Any objections to including this in the next canary?

julie: :thumbsup: add an e2e checklist item: create role -> flip route policy -> assert preview either shows stale badge or blocks -> verify runtime 200/403 as expected.

ashley: telemetry ask: emit events {preview_shown, is_stale, snapshot_version, routing_hint?} so we can correlate preview_stale -> production rejects. Also add a gauge for preview_stale_rate by org.

morgan: thanks — I'll add telemetry, the stale UI affordance, and the strict toggle. Will follow up with PR links and test plan in a separate thread.
